scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/shared build && pnpm --dir packages/cards build && pnpm --dir packages/duel-engine build && pnpm --dir packages/effect-engine build && pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n packages,apps -c blue,green "pnpm --filter \"./packages/*\" --parallel run dev" "wait-on packages/shared/dist/index.d.ts packages/cards/dist/src/index.d.ts packages/cards/dist/effects/index.d.ts packages/duel-engine/dist/index.d.ts packages/effect-engine/dist/index.d.ts && pnpm --dir apps/api dev && wait-on tcp:3000 && pnpm --dir apps/web dev"
